name: Bra
definition: Supportive undergarment worn over the breasts, with cups, straps and a band; wired, wireless, T-shirt, push-up and strapless are types.
notes: Adore Me sells bras as their own category (T-shirt, push-up, wireless, strapless)

name: Panties (briefs, knickers)
definition: Women's underpants covering the hips and crotch, in brief, thong, bikini and high-leg cuts; sold apart from bras.
notes: Adore Me lists Panties as a category separate from Bras, with Thong, Bikini and High Brief styles

name: Boxers and trunks
definition: Men's underpants with short or long legs covering the hips and upper thigh: boxer briefs, trunks and loose boxer shorts.
notes: Suitable sells Men's Boxers and Trunks as a category; MUJI filters Boxer Briefs and Trunks

name: Fedora
definition: Brimmed felt or straw hat with a teardrop or pinched crown and a medium to wide brim, including the trilby.
notes: Hats in the Belfry has a Men's Fedora Hats category of 59 products

name: Bucket hat
definition: Soft brimmed hat with a downward-sloping all-round brim and a crown that is not shaped, of cotton, canvas or similar.
notes: Wimbledon Shop sells a Bucket Hat category beside Baseball Cap, Panama Hat and Visor; Hats in the Belfry lists Bucket under caps

name: Baseball cap
definition: Cap with a rounded crown and a curved or flat peak, adjustable or fitted, in the baseball pattern.
notes: Hats in the Belfry lists Baseball Cap as a style; Wimbledon Shop has a Baseball Cap category

name: Flat cap
definition: Soft cap with a rounded crown stitched to a short stiff front brim, as in the newsboy, ivy and pub cap.
notes: Hats in the Belfry has a Flat Cap category covering newsboy, ivy and pub styles (114 products)

name: Full-face motorcycle helmet
definition: Motorcycle helmet with a fixed chin bar enclosing the whole head and face.
notes: RevZilla sells Full Face as a helmet category beside Modular and Open Face

name: Modular motorcycle helmet
definition: Motorcycle helmet whose chin bar and visor hinge upward (flip-up, system helmet).
notes: RevZilla has a Modular Motorcycle Helmets category

name: Open-face motorcycle helmet
definition: Motorcycle helmet with no chin bar, covering the crown and sides of the head (open face, three-quarter).
notes: RevZilla sells Open Face as a helmet category
